notes: All 34 source and 44 target ids partitioned once, including the discontinuous units for קֹדֶשׁ (t023, t026–t027) and for the clause-final צִוָּה (t043–t044).

Every articular rectum here is rendered anarthrously (*burnt offering*, *incense*, *God*), so rule 29's fronting clause correctly puts each written *the* on the article morpheme rather than on the construct.

The superlative קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים is the one genuinely contested unit; giving *holy place* to s019 (rule 31's own named rendering of קֹדֶשׁ) and *most* to the plural rectum is defensible and the alternative is named in the note.

כִּפֶּר → *make atonement* correctly heads on the complement (rule 44); כְּ → *according to* heads on *according* (rule 24). The לְ of the purpose infinitive takes the English infinitive marker *to*; rule 52's division does not arise because the ASV writes no complementizer.
